    private fun showFullScreenNote(title: String, tag: String, imgPath: String, audioPath: String, index: Int, jsonArray: JSONArray) {
        val currentTheme = prefs.getString("theme_pref", "dark")
        val themeRes = when (currentTheme) {
            "light" -> R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_FullscreenMenu
            "black" -> R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_PitchBlack_FullscreenMenu
            "glass" -> R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_Glass_FullscreenMenu
            else -> R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_FullscreenMenu
        }
        val dialog = android.app.Dialog(this, themeRes)
        dialog.setContentView(R.layout.dialog_fullscreen)

        dialog.window?.let { window ->
            window.setWindowAnimations(R.style.IosModalAnimation)
            if (currentTheme == "glass") {
                window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SHOW_WALLPAPER)
            }

            window.setSoftInputMode(WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_STATE_HIDDEN or WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE)

            WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(window, false)
            androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsControllerCompat(window, window.decorView).apply {
                hide(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
                systemBarsBehavior = androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsControllerCompat.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
            }
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
                window.attributes.layoutInDisplayCutoutMode = WindowManager.LayoutParams.LAYOUT_IN_DISPLAY_CUTOUT_MODE_SHORT_EDGES
            }
        }
        
        dialog.setOnKeyListener { _, keyCode, event ->
            if (keyCode == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK && event.action == android.view.KeyEvent.ACTION_UP) {
                val fullTitle = dialog.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.fsTitle)
                if (fullTitle?.hasFocus() == true) {
                    fullTitle.clearFocus()
                    val imm = getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as InputMethodManager
                    imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(fullTitle.windowToken, 0)
                } else {
                    dialog.dismiss()
                }
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        }

        try {
            val fullImage = dialog.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.fsImage)
            val fullTitle = dialog.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.fsTitle)
            val fullTag = dialog.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.fsTag)
            val fullPlayBtn = dialog.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.fsPlay)
            val btnDelete = dialog.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.fsDelete)
            val btnClose = dialog.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.fsClose)
            val bottomStack = dialog.findViewById<View>(R.id.fullscreenBottomStack)

            bottomStack?.translationY = 80f
            bottomStack?.alpha = 0f
            bottomStack?.animate()
                ?.translationY(0f)
                ?.alpha(1f)
                ?.setStartDelay(100)
                ?.setDuration(350)
                ?.setInterpolator(appleOvershoot)
                ?.start()

            // Dynamically adjust bottom margin based on IME (keyboard) insets
            bottomStack?.let { stack ->
                ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(stack) { v, insets ->
                    val imeHeight = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.ime()).bottom
                    val sysBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars()).bottom
                    val bottomMargin = Math.max(imeHeight, sysBars)
                    
                    val params = v.layoutParams as ViewGroup.MarginLayoutParams
                    params.bottomMargin = bottomMargin + (16 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
                    v.layoutParams = params
                    
                    insets
                }
            }

            fullPlayBtn?.addApplePressEffect()
            btnDelete?.addApplePressEffect()
            btnClose?.addApplePressEffect()

            val font = getAppTypeface()
            val accentColor = getAccentColor()

            fullTitle?.typeface = font
            fullTag?.typeface = font
            fullTag?.setTextColor(accentColor)
            fullPlayBtn?.setColorFilter(accentColor)

            // When title is clicked, show keyboard and padding pushes it up naturally
            fullTitle?.setOnFocusChangeListener { _, hasFocus ->
                if (hasFocus) {
                    val imm = getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as InputMethodManager
                    imm.showSoftInput(fullTitle, InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT)
                }
            }
            
            // Allow clicking outside the text box/stack to close keyboard smoothly
            fullImage?.setOnClickListener {
                if (fullTitle?.hasFocus() == true) {
                    dialog.window?.let { win ->
                        androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsControllerCompat(win, fullTitle).hide(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.ime())
                    }
                    fullTitle.clearFocus()
                } else {
                    showZoomableImage(imgPath)
                }
            }

            btnClose?.setOnClickListener { dialog.dismiss() }

            dialog.setOnDismissListener {
                val newName = fullTitle?.text?.toString()?.trim() ?: ""
                if (newName.isNotEmpty() && newName != title) {
                    try {
                        val noteObj = jsonArray.getJSONObject(index)
                        noteObj.put("summary", newName)
                        prefs.edit().putString("notes_array", jsonArray.toString()).apply()
                        loadDataToMemory()
                        refreshUI()
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                    }
                }
            }

            fullTitle?.setText(title)
            fullTag?.text = tag

            val screenshotWindowCard = dialog.findViewById<View>(R.id.screenshotWindowCard)

            if (imgPath.isNotEmpty() && java.io.File(imgPath).exists()) {
                screenshotWindowCard?.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(imgPath)
                fullImage?.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
                
                // Clicking the screenshot card opens interactive zoom view
                fullImage?.setOnClickListener {
                    showZoomableImage(imgPath)
                }
            }

            fullPlayBtn?.setOnClickListener {
                if (audioPath.isNotEmpty() && java.io.File(audioPath).exists()) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Playing Audio...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    MediaPlayer().apply {
                        setDataSource(audioPath)
                        prepare()
                        start()
                        setOnCompletionListener { release() }
                    }
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "No Audio Attached", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }

            fullTitle?.setOnEditorActionListener { _, actionId, _ ->
                if (actionId == EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_DONE) {
                    val newName = fullTitle.text.toString().trim()
                    if (newName.isNotEmpty()) {
                        try {
                            val noteObj = jsonArray.getJSONObject(index)
                            noteObj.put("summary", newName)

                            prefs.edit().putString("notes_array", jsonArray.toString()).apply()
                            loadDataToMemory()
                            refreshUI()

                            Toast.makeText(this, "Name updated", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            e.printStackTrace()
                        }
                    }

                    fullTitle.clearFocus()
                    val imm = getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as InputMethodManager
                    imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(fullTitle.windowToken, 0)
                    true
                } else {
                    false
                }
            }

            // PRE-LOAD: Read custom tags just once when opening the dialog to eliminate lag
            val savedTags = prefs.getStringSet("custom_tags", setOf("All", "Work", "Personal")) ?: setOf("All", "Work", "Personal")
            val dynamicTagArray = savedTags.filter { it != "All" }.toTypedArray()

            fullTag?.setOnClickListener { view ->
                try {
                    val noteObj = jsonArray.getJSONObject(index)

                    showCategoryFlyout(
                        anchorView = view,
                        noteObj = noteObj,
                        index = index,
                        jsonArray = jsonArray,
                        tagList = dynamicTagArray
                    )
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    e.printStackTrace()
                }
            }

            btnDelete?.setOnClickListener {
                showDeleteNoteDialog(index, jsonArray)
                dialog.dismiss()
            }

        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        dialog.show()
    }
}

=== FILE: C:\Users\dhruv\AndroidStudioProjects\EssentialSpace\app\src\main\java\com\example\essentialspace\NotificationHelper.kt ===
package com.example.essentialspace

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

object NotificationHelper {

    private const val CHANNEL_SILENT_ID = "memory_void_silent"
    private const val CHANNEL_ALERTS_ID = "memory_void_alerts"

    fun createChannels(context: Context) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val manager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
            
            val silentChannel = NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_SILENT_ID, "Recording Status", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW).apply {
                description = "Silent background recording indicators"
                setShowBadge(false)
            }
            
            val alertsChannel = NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ALERTS_ID, "Note Saved Alerts", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH).apply {
                description = "Alerts for newly saved memories"
                setShowBadge(true)
            }
            
            manager.createNotificationChannel(silentChannel)
            manager.createNotificationChannel(alertsChannel)
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    fun showRecordingStarted(context: Context) {
        try {
            createChannels(context)
            if (!hasPermission(context)) return

            val builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_SILENT_ID)
                .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_mic)
                .setContentTitle("Recording Memory...")
                .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_LOW)
                .setOngoing(true)

            NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).notify(1, builder.build())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    fun hideRecordingNotification(context: Context) {
        try {
            NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).cancel(1)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    fun showNoteSaved(context: Context, title: String, noteIndex: Int) {
        try {
            createChannels(context)
            if (!hasPermission(context)) return

            val intent = Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
                flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK
                putExtra("open_note_index", noteIndex)
            }
            val pendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(context, noteIndex, intent, PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE)

            val builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ALERTS_ID)
                .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_custom_void_no_bg)
                .setContentTitle("Memory Saved")
                .setContentText(title)
                .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_HIGH)
                .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)
                .setAutoCancel(true)

            NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).notify(System.currentTimeMillis().toInt(), builder.build())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    private fun hasPermission(context: Context): Boolean {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        }
        return true
    }
}

=== FILE: C:\Users\dhruv\AndroidStudioProjects\EssentialSpace\app\src\main\java\com\example\essentialspace\ThemeManager.kt ===
package com.example.essentialspace

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Build
import android.util.TypedValue
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.ImageButton
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate
import androidx.core.graphics.ColorUtils
import androidx.core.view.WindowCompat
import androidx.swiperefreshlayout.widget.SwipeRefreshLayout

object ThemeManager {

    const val THEME_LIGHT = "light"
    const val THEME_DARK = "dark"
    const val THEME_BLACK = "black"
    const val THEME_GLASS = "glass"

    private const val PREFS_NAME = "EssentialNotes"
    private const val KEY_THEME = "theme_pref"
    private const val KEY_ACCENT = "accent_color"

    fun getPrefs(context: Context): SharedPreferences {
        return context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    }

    fun getCurrentThemeKey(context: Context): String {
        return getPrefs(context).getString(KEY_THEME, THEME_DARK) ?: THEME_DARK
    }

    fun initActivityTheme(activity: AppCompatActivity) {
        val themeKey = getCurrentThemeKey(activity)
        val mode = if (themeKey == THEME_LIGHT) AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_NO else AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES
        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(mode)

        when (themeKey) {
            THEME_BLACK -> {
                activity.setTheme(R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_PitchBlack)
                activity.window.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SHOW_WALLPAPER)
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
                    activity.window.setBackgroundBlurRadius(0)
                }
            }
            THEME_GLASS -> {
                activity.setTheme(R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_Glass)
                activity.window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SHOW_WALLPAPER)
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
                    activity.window.setBackgroundBlurRadius(60)
                }
            }
            else -> {
                activity.setTheme(R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace)
                activity.window.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SHOW_WALLPAPER)
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
                    activity.window.setBackgroundBlurRadius(0)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun applyTheme(activity: Activity, themeKey: String) {
        getPrefs(activity).edit().putString(KEY_THEME, themeKey).commit()
        val mode = if (themeKey == THEME_LIGHT) AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_NO else AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES
        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(mode)

        // Instant clean activity restart with zero animation delay
        val intent = activity.intent
        activity.finish()
        activity.startActivity(intent)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE) {
            activity.overrideActivityTransition(Activity.OVERRIDE_TRANSITION_CLOSE, 0, 0)
            activity.overrideActivityTransition(Activity.OVERRIDE_TRANSITION_OPEN, 0, 0)
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            activity.overridePendingTransition(0, 0)
        }
    }

    fun getPrimaryColor(context: Context): Int {
        val typedValue = TypedValue()
        context.theme.resolveAttribute(android.R.attr.textColorPrimary, typedValue, true)
        return typedValue.data
    }

    fun getAccentColor(context: Context): Int {
        val primary = getPrimaryColor(context)
        return getPrefs(context).getInt(KEY_ACCENT, primary)
    }

    fun setAccentColor(context: Context, color: Int?) {
        val prefs = getPrefs(context)
        if (color == null || color == getPrimaryColor(context)) {
            prefs.edit().remove(KEY_ACCENT).commit()
        } else {
            prefs.edit().putInt(KEY_ACCENT, color).commit()
        }
    }

    fun getThemeDialogRes(context: Context): Int {
        return when (getCurrentThemeKey(context)) {
            THEME_LIGHT -> R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_FullscreenMenu
            THEME_BLACK -> R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_PitchBlack_FullscreenMenu
            THEME_GLASS -> R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_Glass_FullscreenMenu
            else -> R.style.Theme_EssentialSpace_FullscreenMenu
        }
    }

    fun getContrastingTextColor(backgroundColor: Int): Int {
        val luminance = ColorUtils.calculateLuminance(backgroundColor)
        return if (luminance > 0.55) Color.BLACK else Color.WHITE
    }

    @android.annotation.SuppressLint("ResourceType")
    fun applyThemeColorsToMain(activity: Activity) {
        val themeKey = getCurrentThemeKey(activity)
        val accent = getAccentColor(activity)

        val ta = activity.obtainStyledAttributes(intArrayOf(
            android.R.attr.colorBackground,
            android.R.attr.textColorPrimary,
            android.R.attr.textColorSecondary,
            com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorSurfaceVariant
        ))
        val colorBackground = ta.getColor(0, Color.BLACK)
        val textColorPrimary = ta.getColor(1, Color.WHITE)
        val textColorSecondary = ta.getColor(2, Color.GRAY)
        val colorSurfaceVariant = ta.getColor(3, Color.DKGRAY)
        ta.recycle()

        // Configure Light/Dark Status Bar Icons
        WindowCompat.getInsetsController(activity.window, activity.window.decorView).isAppearanceLightStatusBars = (themeKey == THEME_LIGHT)

        // Root View Background
        activity.findViewById<View>(android.R.id.content)?.rootView?.setBackgroundColor(colorBackground)

        // Title and Icons Tint
        activity.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvHome)?.setTextColor(textColorPrimary)
        activity.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.btnMenu)?.setColorFilter(textColorPrimary)
        activity.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.btnCreateNote)?.setColorFilter(textColorPrimary)

        // Dynamic Gradient Overlays matching colorBackground
        val topFade = activity.findViewById<View>(R.id.topFadeOverlay)
        val bottomFade = activity.findViewById<View>(R.id.bottomFadeOverlay)

        val startAlpha = if (themeKey == THEME_GLASS) 0x66 else 0xCC
        val fadeColor = Color.argb(startAlpha, Color.red(colorBackground), Color.green(colorBackground), Color.blue(colorBackground))
        val endColor = Color.argb(0, Color.red(colorBackground), Color.green(colorBackground), Color.blue(colorBackground))

        topFade?.background = GradientDrawable(GradientDrawable.Orientation.TOP_BOTTOM, intArrayOf(fadeColor, endColor))
        bottomFade?.background = GradientDrawable(GradientDrawable.Orientation.BOTTOM_TOP, intArrayOf(fadeColor, endColor))

        // Floating Dock Card & Search Button
        val dockCard = activity.findViewById<com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>(R.id.dockCard)
        dockCard?.setCardBackgroundColor(colorSurfaceVariant)
        dockCard?.strokeColor = accent
        dockCard?.strokeWidth = (1 * activity.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

        val btnSearchBubble = activity.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.btnSearchBubble)
        btnSearchBubble?.setColorFilter(accent)

        val searchBar = activity.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.searchBar)
        searchBar?.setTextColor(textColorPrimary)
        searchBar?.setHintTextColor(textColorSecondary)

        activity.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.searchIconExpanded)?.setColorFilter(accent)

        // SwipeRefresh Layout Colors
        val swipe = activity.findViewById<SwipeRefreshLayout>(R.id.swipeRefresh)
        swipe?.setColorSchemeColors(accent)
        swipe?.setProgressBackgroundColorSchemeColor(colorSurfaceVariant)
    }
}
